subject: MdeModulePkg: Use EFI_PAGES_TO_SIZE macro in ArmFfaSecRxTxMap
reasons: C code change with a precise structural replacement.
The before/after pattern is explicit: replace `PcdGet64(PcdFfaTxRxPageCount) * EFI_PAGE_SIZE` with `EFI_PAGES_TO_SIZE(PcdGet64(PcdFfaTxRxPageCount))`.
The same transformation is repeated multiple times in the same file with little to no variation.
This is API/helper-macro migration style work, which fits Coccinelle well.
Scope is limited to one file, but repetition is high enough to still make it a reasonable semantic-patch candidate.
